t: What is owed to a person once they pray with you
a: مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَتَنَا، وَاسْتَقْبَلَ قِبْلَتَنَا، وَأَكَلَ ذَبِيحَتَنَا، فَذَلِكَ الْمُسْلِمُ الَّذِي لَهُ ذِمَّةُ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةُ رَسُولِهِ، فَلاَ تُخْفِرُوا اللَّهَ
p: Man ṣallā ṣalātanā wa-staqbala qiblatanā wa akala dhabīḥatanā, fa-dhālika-l-muslimu-lladhī lahu dhimmatu-Llāhi wa dhimmatu rasūlih, fa-lā tukhfirū-Llāh
m: Whoever prays our prayer, faces our direction and eats what we slaughter, that is the Muslim who has the protection of Allah and the protection of His Messenger. So do not betray Allah in what He has guaranteed.
